item.title: ‘Faced criticism but we…’: What PM Modi said on India-US trade deal at key NDA meet
item.description: US President Donald Trump and PM Modi had earlier held several rounds of negotiations to materialise the trade deal, but the talks hit a roadblock after Trump imposed 50 per cent tariffs on Indian goods.

item.title: Nvidia–OpenAI $100 billion deal explained: What Jensen Huang really said
item.description: Nvidia clarified it never committed to a single $100B investment in OpenAI, with CEO Jensen Huang saying funding will happen gradually, round by round. OpenAI chief Sam Altman dismissed the rumors, praised Nvidia’s AI chips, and reaffirmed a long-term partnership between the two companies.

item.title: Why head & neck cancer surgery is about preserving speech, swallowing
item.description: Head and neck cancer surgery has evolved beyond the usual goal of tumor removal. Today’s surgical decisions are informed by an extensive preoperative evaluation of speech, swallowing, airway safety, and anatomical function. Each incision, margin, and rebuilding is designed to preserve these vital processes while removing cancer completely.

item.title: Uttarakhand forests blaze in winter; 41 fire incidents in two months, major incident in Nanda Devi Reserve
item.description: Forest fires in Uttarakhand during winter have shocked experts, with 41 incidents reported in just two months. Flames have reached the Valley of Flowers and Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve, endangered rare wildlife and highlighting the growing impact of climate change.

item.title: Maharashtra minister Pankaja Munde’s helicopter develops technical snag before take-off in Sambhajinagar
item.description: The pilot identified the fault moments before departure and advised against flying. The trip was immediately postponed on safety grounds. Munde was scheduled to address multiple campaign rallies across Latur district as part of her Marathwada tour.

item.title: Mumbai Flower Festival returns to Byculla zoo with free entry for citizens
item.description: Mumbai Flower Festival will return to Byculla zoo this February with free entry for visitors. Organised by BMC, the three-day event will showcase floral displays, plants, and gardening activities for citizens. Here are the details.

item.description: Nadda said the Congress and INDIA bloc MPs should now let it function as Centre is ready for a discussion over the trade deal.

item.title: Uttarakhand bus accident: Himachal Roadways bus falls into 100-meter gorge, three dead, many injured
item.description: A Himachal Roadways bus carrying over 30 passengers fell into a 100-meter-deep gorge near Vikasnagar, Uttarakhand, on February 3, 2026. SDRF teams launched a rescue operation immediately, with three deaths confirmed and several passengers seriously injured. The Chief Minister expressed deep sorrow.

item.title: NEET SS 2026 scorecard link active; here’s how to download at natboard.edu.in
item.description: Candidates who have passed the NEET SS 2026 exam can log in and download the scorecard. The scorecard will be available for download only for a period of six months.
